dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature resulting in a slightly falcate profile from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the terminal morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree angular steepness relative to the longitudinal horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured ratio of approximately 1.3:1 comparing the maximum base width to the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gentle convex arc with a large radius extending from the mid-cranium to the rostrum base inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick pixel representation with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clear obtuse interior angle where the melon's descent meets the dorsal surface of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-luminance circular pixel cluster located on the distal posterior margin of the upper fluke lobe.
